text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In front of the candy store in the 
shopping district, Nakayama Festa and Gold 
Ship were facing off against a bunch of 
kids with dead serious looks on their 
faces.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now then... let both sides reveal their 
chosen "Prize-Winning Kinako Mochi"!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —"Win".

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: ...! It-It's a "Lose"... again...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With this, the Brat Brigade sits at 9 
losses, a 35% chance of sunshowers... and 
200% pure lemon juice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Should you suffer a 10th defeat, it's 
instant game over! In addition to all the 
"Kinako Mochi" piled up so far—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You will have to treat the winning side to 
ten times that amount in cheap candy!

text_block_list.name: Brat Team
text_block_list.text: Guh... Gaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You're runnin' pretty low on ammo about 
now. Take my advice. Call it quits right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What!? You're tellin' us to just 
walk away losers...!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then let me ask you... you seriously think 
you're gonna win the next one? Think you 
can win 10 in a row without dropping a 
single round from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Countin' on miracles. —That's how ruined 
gamblers think, kid.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: ............ Mind... your own business...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you always say it yourself! When 
you're pushed right to the absolute 
brink... that thrilling burn is the best 
thing ever...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally... just starting to understand 
what that feels like...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so— the result of the fateful kinako 
mochi reveal was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ..."Win". ...What about you, punk?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well. That's just the cold hard reality 
of gambling for ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Alright then. I've got enough cash on me. 
You twerps go ahead and pick whatever 
candy you want. My treat.

text_block_list.name: Brat Team
text_block_list.text:
...Huh!? Wh-Why're you treating us, big 
sis...? We're the ones who lost, aren't 
we...!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Idiots. You really think I'd get serious 
over playing for keeps against a bunch of 
kids?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, aren't we being extra sweet 
today?! I thought you were the kind of 
gambler who loved going easy on people 
just to suck 'em dry right down to the 
marrow!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. ...Even I don't get a thrill out 
of just any random gamble.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
...Don't treat us like babies...! Take 
what you won fair and square...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk big, brat! I'm tellin' you I'm 
not in the mood for it.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'll make you get in the mood...! 
Let's go one more round...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna feel the burn even more... and 
climb all the way up to your level, big 
sis...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, look who's all fired up! Tumbling and 
climbing up the slopes of hell, are we on 
3rd Street yet?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Talk about a terrible 
influence... I really am the worst kind of 
role model...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well... whatever. ...You've got good eyes 
right now, kid.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here. Don't be shy, grab whatever snacks 
you—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on, STOOOP!! Don't just move 
things along on your own! As the witness, 
I can't let breach of contract slide!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What do you want, then?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sanctions! Golshi-chan is gonna squeeze 
every last drop out of all of you with the 
Stretchy Gummy Boing-Boing Game!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... fine by me. Sounds way more 
entertaining than playing with the 
brats...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with the witness joining in, the 
game at the candy shop grew even more 
heated.
